content.text: Lots of kids Milo's age are still co-sleeping, and it's very doable to change. Start tonight with a bedtime routine in his own bed that ends the same way every time, like two books, lights low, then a calm goodnight. Tell him ahead of time that this is the new plan, and stay close at first, sitting on the floor next to his bed. Then move a little farther away every few nights.
